description: Express.js route handlers for tracking lesson and course progress, including recording completions, retrieving user progress, and notifying instructors upon course completion.

methods.name: POST /progress/lessons/:lessonId/complete
methods.description: Records completion of a lesson by a learner.

methods.name: GET /progress/users/:userId
methods.description: Retrieves lesson completion count and IDs for a user (manager view).

methods.name: POST /progress/courses/:courseId/complete
methods.description: Records course completion by a learner and notifies the instructor.
